faultLoc.explanation: The NullPointerException indicates that the 'source' string might be null. The method does not check for null values before attempting to use the 'source' string. This can cause the Matcher to throw a NullPointerException when it tries to access the length of the null 'source' string.

The 'removePattern' method calls 'replacePattern' without checking if 'source' or 'regex' are null. If 'source' is null, it will propagate the null value to 'replacePattern', which will then cause a NullPointerException as seen in the test results.
